owner: source-only preparation; numeric implementation and receipts owned by full3d operator agent

root_decision.C_functional: same six physical volume-average translation/rotation moments about a fixed center and scale
root_decision.future_growth: cohesive-history dissipation delta_Dcoh; no additional Gc*delta_area

basis_and_solve.layout: 93 semantic DOFs: 81 BASE + 12 GLOBAL_FRONT (F1..F4 x ux,uy,uz)
basis_and_solve.basis_update: preserve same BASE source/MLS rows; analytically rebuild all shifted GLOBAL_FRONT values and gradients
basis_and_solve.baseline_solution: fresh equilibrium solve with g=0; cached manufactured nonzero-g q_solution is not a baseline
basis_and_solve.gauge_functional: Cq=V^-1 integral [ux,uy,uz,((x-center) cross u)/R] dV; center=(0,0,0), R=0.01m; mode order tx,ty,tz,rx,ry,rz
basis_and_solve.rebuild_C: represent the same physical volume-moment functional in each geometry basis

frozen_load.basis_load_rule: reintegrate f(a)_j=sum_q area_weight_q * N_j(a,x_q) dot traction_q; f_old and f_candidate may differ

quadrature.volume_rule: 512 rows; GL4 s x GL32 theta x GL4 z; at a=0 r=R*s^2 and dV=2*R^2*s^3 ds dtheta dz; full cylinder, open nodes
quadrature.side_rule: 256 rows; GL64 theta x GL4 z; n=(cos(theta),sin(theta),0); dA=R dtheta dz
quadrature.cap_rule: 512 rows total; per cap GL4 on inner/outer radial segments split at c=0.5mm and GL16 on each theta semicircle; inner r=c*sin(pi*s/2)^2, outer r=c+(R-c)*s^2, dA=r*(dr/ds)ds dtheta

query_budget.candidate_operation: reuse exact BASE MLS values/gradients; analytically recompute shifted GLOBAL_FRONT branch values/gradients on all assembly rows
query_budget.on_mismatch: BLOCK; no silent query or adaptivity

per_state_energy: W=f^T*q J plus independent frozen-boundary integral

later_damage_growth.Gc_delta_area: not added for the same cohesive damage
